item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.responses`, constructs `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"responses\")`, calls `lm.forward(...)`, and asserts against captured outbound `input` kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Sends one `user` message with list-form multimodal `content` and inspects `captured[0][\"input\"][0][\"content\"]`, preserving order across text, image, and file."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the first converted item has type `input_text` and preserves the original text field exactly."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the image converts from nested `image_url.url` chat format to top-level `image_url` with type `input_image`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the file converts to `input_file` and preserves both `file_id` and `filename` in the converted payload."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `openai/gpt-5-mini` with `temperature=1.0` and `max_tokens=16000`, satisfying reasoning-model constructor requirements."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
